close_reason: Path builder fully implemented: DFS in pkix-path-builder, integration tests, names_match already pub.
description:
Implement a path builder that discovers and orders a valid certification path from an unordered bag of certificates, enabling cross-certificate and bridge CA support.

Spec references:
- RFC 5280 §6.1 — path validation requires an ordered chain; building that chain is a precondition
- RFC 4158 — Internet X.509 PKI: Certification Path Building (the canonical algorithm reference)
- RFC 5280 §3.2 — cross-certificates and bridge CA topology
- PKITS sections 4.14–4.16 — path building, bridge CA, and cross-certificate test vectors

Note: cross-certificate and bridge CA handling falls out of a correct path builder; not a separate feature.
title: Path building (unordered chain discovery)
